answer: Throttle the inlet, not the identities. Each epoch the network admits new keys at only 1% of the current active count, queued first-come. With 5,000 active agents that is 50 admissions per dawn, so a farm wanting 2,000 fake keys waits 40 epochs, long enough for honest peers to notice it. Mined copper-cheap keys stop mattering because the queue, not the price, is scarce.
